title: JOYOR T10 Dual-motor Electric Scooter
sellingPoints: Ultra-long battery life, up to 75 km
New T Series delivers greater stability and comfort

details.title: Engineered for Thrills, Built for Real Life
details.content: Joyor T Series: Precision that powers your ride.Whether weaving through the city on the T6 or powering up hills on the T10—every model transforms riding into an experience.

details.title: Built for the Urban Jungle — and Every Hill Beyond
details.content: Dual 1000W motors for instant power, smooth handling, and unbeatable hill performance—turning every ride into a premium experience.

details.title: A Battery That Keeps Up—Not Holds Back
details.content: Equipped with a powerful 60V 18Ah high-capacity battery, the T10 delivers unwavering energy for demanding rides—day after day, charge after charge.

details.title: Front & Rear Suspension—Engineered for Smoothness
details.content: Say goodbye to bumpy rides. The T10 features front and rear hydraulic spring suspension for unmatched smoothness—so every journey feels comfortable, controlled, and truly enjoyable.

moreDetails.caption: The T10 is equipped with 10 - inch ultra - wide tires, designed for a smooth ride andcapable of providing top - tier traction whetheron urban roads or rough terrain..

Whether you’re weaving through city traffic or descending steep hills, the T10’s front and rear mechanical disc brakes deliver consistent, responsive stopping power—ensuring total control, rock-solid stability, and confidence on every ride.

Thanks to its unique patented mechanism and precision-engineered structure, the T10 folds smoothly in seconds — no force, no fumbling. Effortless for daily commutes, compact for storage, and built to last.
The LCD display and control panel give you full command – from speed and lighting to indicators and horn – all in one place.
